solution: Here \(\frac{1}{x^2-9} = \frac{1}{(x-3)(x+3)} = \frac{1}{6}\left(\frac{1}{x-3} - \frac{1}{x+3}\right)\). Hence \(\int \frac{dx}{x^2-9} = \frac{1}{6}\big(\log|x-3| - \log|x+3|\big) + C = \frac{1}{6}\log\left|\frac{x-3}{x+3}\right| + C\).

The fraction is improper; dividing, \(\frac{1-x^2}{x(1-2x)} = \frac{1}{2} + \frac{1-\frac{x}{2}}{x(1-2x)}\). Write \(\frac{1-\frac{x}{2}}{x(1-2x)} = \frac{A}{x} + \frac{B}{1-2x}\), so \(1-\tfrac{x}{2} = A(1-2x)+Bx\). Put \(x=0\): \(A=1\); \(x=\tfrac{1}{2}\): \(\tfrac{3}{4}=\tfrac{B}{2}\Rightarrow B=\tfrac{3}{2}\). Hence \(\int \frac{1-x^2}{x(1-2x)}\,dx = \int\left(\frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{x} + \frac{3}{2(1-2x)}\right)dx = \frac{x}{2} + \log|x| - \frac{3}{4}\log|1-2x| + C\).

Let \(\frac{x}{(x^2+1)(x-1)} = \frac{Ax+B}{x^2+1} + \frac{C}{x-1}\), so \(x = (Ax+B)(x-1) + C(x^2+1)\). Put \(x=1\): \(1=2C\Rightarrow C=\tfrac{1}{2}\); comparing \(x^2\): \(A+C=0\Rightarrow A=-\tfrac{1}{2}\); comparing \(x\): \(B-A=1\Rightarrow B=\tfrac{1}{2}\). Then \(\int \frac{x}{(x^2+1)(x-1)}\,dx = \int\left(\frac{-\tfrac{1}{2}x+\tfrac{1}{2}}{x^2+1} + \frac{\tfrac{1}{2}}{x-1}\right)dx = -\frac{1}{4}\log(x^2+1) + \frac{1}{2}\tan^{-1}x + \frac{1}{2}\log|x-1| + C\).

Let \(\frac{x}{(x-1)^2(x+2)} = \frac{A}{x-1} + \frac{B}{(x-1)^2} + \frac{C}{x+2}\), so \(x = A(x-1)(x+2) + B(x+2) + C(x-1)^2\). Put \(x=1\): \(1=3B\Rightarrow B=\tfrac{1}{3}\); \(x=-2\): \(-2=9C\Rightarrow C=-\tfrac{2}{9}\); comparing \(x^2\): \(A+C=0\Rightarrow A=\tfrac{2}{9}\). Then \(\int \frac{x}{(x-1)^2(x+2)}\,dx = \frac{2}{9}\log|x-1| - \frac{1}{3(x-1)} - \frac{2}{9}\log|x+2| + C\).

The fraction is improper; dividing, \(\frac{x^3+x+1}{x^2-1} = x + \frac{2x+1}{x^2-1}\). Write \(\frac{2x+1}{(x-1)(x+1)} = \frac{A}{x-1} + \frac{B}{x+1}\), so \(2x+1 = A(x+1)+B(x-1)\). Put \(x=1\): \(3=2A\Rightarrow A=\tfrac{3}{2}\); \(x=-1\): \(-1=-2B\Rightarrow B=\tfrac{1}{2}\). Then \(\int \frac{x^3+x+1}{x^2-1}\,dx = \frac{x^2}{2} + \frac{3}{2}\log|x-1| + \frac{1}{2}\log|x+1| + C\).

Let \(\frac{2}{(1-x)(1+x^2)} = \frac{A}{1-x} + \frac{Bx+C}{1+x^2}\), so \(2 = A(1+x^2) + (Bx+C)(1-x)\). Put \(x=1\): \(2=2A\Rightarrow A=1\); comparing \(x^2\): \(A-B=0\Rightarrow B=1\); comparing \(x\): \(B-C=0\Rightarrow C=1\). Then \(\int \frac{2}{(1-x)(1+x^2)}\,dx = \int\left(\frac{1}{1-x} + \frac{x+1}{1+x^2}\right)dx = -\log|1-x| + \frac{1}{2}\log(1+x^2) + \tan^{-1}x + C\).

Put \(t = x+2\), so \(dt=dx\) and \(3x-1 = 3t-7\). Then \(\int \frac{3x-1}{(x+2)^2}\,dx = \int \frac{3t-7}{t^2}\,dt = \int\left(\frac{3}{t} - \frac{7}{t^2}\right)dt = 3\log|t| + \frac{7}{t} + C = 3\log|x+2| + \frac{7}{x+2} + C\).

Factor \(x^4-1=(x-1)(x+1)(x^2+1)\). Let \(\frac{1}{x^4-1} = \frac{A}{x-1} + \frac{B}{x+1} + \frac{Cx+D}{x^2+1}\), so \(1 = A(x+1)(x^2+1) + B(x-1)(x^2+1) + (Cx+D)(x^2-1)\). Put \(x=1\): \(A=\tfrac{1}{4}\); \(x=-1\): \(B=-\tfrac{1}{4}\); comparing \(x^3\): \(A+B+C=0\Rightarrow C=0\); constant: \(A-B-D=1\Rightarrow D=-\tfrac{1}{2}\). Then \(\int \frac{dx}{x^4-1} = \frac{1}{4}\log|x-1| - \frac{1}{4}\log|x+1| - \frac{1}{2}\tan^{-1}x + C = \frac{1}{4}\log\left|\frac{x-1}{x+1}\right| - \frac{1}{2}\tan^{-1}x + C\).

Multiply numerator and denominator by \(x^{n-1}\): \(\frac{1}{x(x^n+1)} = \frac{x^{n-1}}{x^n(x^n+1)}\). Put \(t = x^n\), so \(dt = n\,x^{n-1}\,dx\). Then \(\int \frac{dx}{x(x^n+1)} = \frac{1}{n}\int \frac{dt}{t(t+1)} = \frac{1}{n}\int\left(\frac{1}{t} - \frac{1}{t+1}\right)dt = \frac{1}{n}\log\left|\frac{t}{t+1}\right| + C = \frac{1}{n}\log\left|\frac{x^n}{x^n+1}\right| + C\).

Put \(t = \sin x\), so \(dt = \cos x\,dx\). Then \(\int \frac{\cos x}{(1-\sin x)(2-\sin x)}\,dx = \int \frac{dt}{(1-t)(2-t)}\). Since \(\frac{1}{(1-t)(2-t)} = \frac{1}{1-t} - \frac{1}{2-t}\), this equals \(-\log|1-t| + \log|2-t| + C = \log\left|\frac{2-\sin x}{1-\sin x}\right| + C\).

Put \(t = x^2\), so \(dt = 2x\,dx\). Then \(\int \frac{2x}{(x^2+1)(x^2+3)}\,dx = \int \frac{dt}{(t+1)(t+3)}\). Since \(\frac{1}{(t+1)(t+3)} = \frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{1}{t+1} - \frac{1}{t+3}\right)\), this equals \(\frac{1}{2}\log\left|\frac{t+1}{t+3}\right| + C = \frac{1}{2}\log\left(\frac{x^2+1}{x^2+3}\right) + C\).

Multiply numerator and denominator by \(x^3\): \(\frac{1}{x(x^4-1)} = \frac{x^3}{x^4(x^4-1)}\). Put \(t = x^4\), so \(dt = 4x^3\,dx\). Then \(\int \frac{dx}{x(x^4-1)} = \frac{1}{4}\int \frac{dt}{t(t-1)} = \frac{1}{4}\int\left(\frac{1}{t-1} - \frac{1}{t}\right)dt = \frac{1}{4}\log\left|\frac{t-1}{t}\right| + C = \frac{1}{4}\log\left|\frac{x^4-1}{x^4}\right| + C\).

Put \(t = e^x\), so \(dt = e^x\,dx\) and \(dx = \frac{dt}{t}\). Then \(\int \frac{dx}{e^x-1} = \int \frac{dt}{t(t-1)} = \int\left(\frac{1}{t-1} - \frac{1}{t}\right)dt = \log|t-1| - \log|t| + C = \log\left|\frac{e^x-1}{e^x}\right| + C = \log|e^x-1| - x + C\).

Let \(\frac{5x}{(x+1)(x^2+9)} = \frac{A}{x+1} + \frac{Bx+C}{x^2+9}\), so \(5x = A(x^2+9) + (Bx+C)(x+1)\). Put \(x=-1\): \(-5=10A\Rightarrow A=-\tfrac{1}{2}\); comparing \(x^2\): \(A+B=0\Rightarrow B=\tfrac{1}{2}\); constant: \(9A+C=0\Rightarrow C=\tfrac{9}{2}\). Then \(\int \frac{5x}{(x+1)(x^2+9)}\,dx = -\frac{1}{2}\log|x+1| + \frac{1}{4}\log(x^2+9) + \frac{3}{2}\tan^{-1}\frac{x}{3} + C\).

Put \(t = e^x\), so \(dt = e^x\,dx\). Then \(\int \frac{e^x}{(1+e^x)(2+e^x)}\,dx = \int \frac{dt}{(1+t)(2+t)}\). Since \(\frac{1}{(1+t)(2+t)} = \frac{1}{1+t} - \frac{1}{2+t}\), this equals \(\log|1+t| - \log|2+t| + C = \log\left(\frac{1+e^x}{2+e^x}\right) + C\).

Write \(\frac{1}{x^2(x+1)} = \frac{A}{x} + \frac{B}{x^2} + \frac{C}{x+1}\), so \(1 = Ax(x+1) + B(x+1) + Cx^2\). Put \(x=0\): \(B=1\); \(x=-1\): \(C=1\); comparing \(x^2\): \(A+C=0\Rightarrow A=-1\). Hence an antiderivative is \(\int \frac{dx}{x^2(x+1)} = -\log|x| - \frac{1}{x} + \log|x+1| = \log\left|\frac{x+1}{x}\right| - \frac{1}{x}\). Evaluating from \(1\) to \(3\): \(\left(\log\frac{4}{3} - \frac{1}{3}\right) - \left(\log 2 - 1\right) = \log\frac{4}{6} + \frac{2}{3} = \frac{2}{3} + \log\frac{2}{3}\), as required.
